headlines.description: Barcelona restored their three-point lead at the top of LaLiga with a stunning second-half comeback against Villarreal at the Nou Camp.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barcelona fight back against Villarreal to win 3-2 and restore three-point lead at the top of LaLiga

video.headline: Barcelona fight back to restore lead at top of LaLiga
